page.layout: One page of running text, with two groups of small italic notes set below the text, the first beneath the first paragraph and the second beneath the second and third. Printed page number at the head centre. No running head. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: Verùm si Iudex copiam sui non præbeat, ut quia vel abfit,{a} vel metum appellanti incutiat, an ob id appellationis via præclusa videri debet? Minimè. Eo enim casu, rectà ad superiorem Iudicem præsto appellari poterit.{b}

{a} Quod tum accidisse dicitur, quando jese[?] in publico non oftendit l. 1. §. dies 7. & §. adeundi ff. Quand. appel. fit. b) d.l. 1. §. dies ff. Eod. Alterutrius enim copiam habere sufficit. d.l. 1. §. si quis 10. arg. L. si longius 18. ff. de Iudic. Lanfr. de Orian. in pr. iud. c. 10. n. 82. cum aliquot seqq.
Quid si nec huius adeundi facultas detur? Tum pars appellare volens, protestari saltem de sua voluntate: vel appellationem (ut usu hodie obtinuit) coram Notario & testibus interponere poterit.

a) Rob. Mar. h.t. n. 133. & Bart. in l. 1. ff. h.t. & l. 1. §. dies ff. Quand. appel. fit. l. cum quidam 7. ff. h.t. l. aut qui 5. & si forte. ff. Quod vi aut clam. l. vlt. C. de His qui per met. iud. non appel. l. in omnibus causis 39. de R.I. b) Lanfr. de Oria. in pr. iud. d. c. 10. n. 55. Mynsing. Cent. 2. obs. 2. n. 4. & Cent. 4. obs. 45. per c. vlt. h.t. c. pastoralis 11. §. praeterea, de offic. ord. Ord. Cam. part. 2. tit. 39. §. Item [illegible, ~10 letters] jeten. Guid. Pap. h.t. q. 56. Specul. h.t. §. nunc ducamus n. 10.

Fit autem appellatio, vel in scriptis, vel viva voce, Utroq; modo à sententia Definitiua. Posteriori, quando ilico & ex continenti, a){c} ea instituitur. b) Priori, quando ex interuallo, nam tum res haec omnino scriptis peragenda est. c)

a) iudice scilicet adhuc pro tribunali sedente, nec ad extraneos actus diuertente. l. diuum 7. ff. de in integ. resti. l. litigatoribus 14. C. h.t. l. a sententia 5. §. fin. ff. Eod. Mar. h.t. n. 136. cum seq. Mynf. Cent. 2. obs. 12. & Cent. 3. obs. 15. n. 15. Lanfr. de Oriano in pr. iud. c. 10. n. 49. Specul. h.t. §. qualiter. n. 1. b) ut si dicat, Appello. C. neminem etiam experimendo) not. Bart. in l. 1. in fin. ff. h.t. & in l. qui Romae §. Sei aff. de V.O. Guid. Pap. h.t. q. 5. c) l. 1. in fin. cum l. seq. ff. h.t. l. litigatoribus 14. ubi DD. C. h.t. Specul. in d. §. qualiter.

page.notes: Top centre "L" read as the printed page number. Left-bottom signature read as "C 3" with uncertainty because the figure is smudged. Catchword "LIII. Ab" partly smudged. The line beginning "Item" in the first footnote group is largely illegible from the scan. Marks {a} and {b} in the text are the small printed reference marks; the footnote letters a), b), c) are printed in the notes and their positions are approximate. "jese" and "Lsi" are doubtful readings. Possible printing error: "resti." for "restit." is not certain; read as printed.
